page.overview:
Who is Vegapants?

Vegapants is a joke character invented by a fan in the SBS and jokingly accepted by Oda. He is the cousin of Vegapunk (being the son of his father's younger brother) who resides on the island of Pants Hazard.

Vegapants is very similar in appearance to his cousin Vegapunk, having the same elongated tongue and head shape. He possesses curly dark hair that is arranged into two pigtails on top; as is normal for residents of Pants Hazard, he wears a pair of women's underwear on the top of his head; the underwear he dons bears a heart pattern. He also wears round glasses and a jacket with two breast pockets.

Vegapants is said to have an earnest and bright personality, but this is tempered by Pants Hazard's isolation from the rest of the world. He follows Pants Hazard's custom of wearing women's undergarments on his head.

At some point in the past Vegapants was born to the little brother of Vegapunk's father. He has seemingly resided on Pants Hazard his entire life.
